crossRefs.note: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
He said to the men of Succoth, “Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me; for they are faint, and I am…
Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else…
What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?
and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.
I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write…

translations.web: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!
translations.bsb: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the backs of fools!
translations.kjv: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool's back.
translations.asv: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, And a rod for the back of fools.
